headlines.title: Asian LNG Prices Surge Past $30 as Middle East Shipping Risks Escalate
headlines.summary: Liquefied natural gas prices on the Asian spot market topped $30 per million British thermal units for the first time since December 2022, Bloomberg reported earlier today. The price jump follows a report about a strike on an LNG tanker in the Gulf of Aden, off the Yemeni coast.
